    static void
    GameGUI.startDungeon(Dungeon dungeon)
    Enters a dungeon for the first time: resets Yohane's turn counter so turn-interval effects (bat move cadence, the boss fight's every-8-turn bat summon) always start from a clean 0 rather than whatever parity was left over from the previous dungeon; sets the dungeon as current; places Yohane on its first floor; and clears the underlying 'Y' tile so it's not drawn twice.
